tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and irregular raw prefixes match the archived memory-kernel ODE, but five observations are insufficient to identify its four coupled parameters reliably. The extra trajectory batch directly resolves this ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Coupled two-state memory ODE fitted to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archived mechanism has four coupled parameters and explicitly requires at least eight rows; five rows leave genuine identifiability ambiguity.
The observed history dependence and transient lag point to the memory mechanism rather than a static sink-gradient branch.
Deferred until the additional trajectories can distinguish it from the coupled memory mechanism.
